explain.say: Think of a tiny bird tweeting and a big lion roaring. The tweet is high and the roar is low. How high or low a sound is, is called pitch. Look at the board: four string instruments, from the little violin to the giant double bass.

explain.say: Every sound is something vibrating, which means wobbling back and forth very fast. Look at the wave on the board. Fast wobbles make a high pitch; slow wobbles make a low pitch. Can you feel your throat wobble when you hum?

draw.name: x-wave
draw.note: More wobbles each second means a higher pitch

explain.say: Now look at the double bass, the biggest one, as tall as a grown-up. Its long, heavy strings wobble slowly, so it plays the lowest notes. The small violin has short, light strings that wobble fast, so it sings high. Which do you think sounds lowest, the cello or the viola?

explain.say: Look at the graph. As a string gets longer, its pitch goes down. That is why a guitarist presses a string to make it shorter and the note goes up. On a sitar from India or a koto from Japan, it works the same way. What happens to the pitch when the string gets shorter?

It goes up! Fantastic listening. Wow fact: a piano's lowest note wobbles about 27 times a second and its highest over 4000 times a second. Challenge: stretch a rubber band over a box and pluck it, then stretch it tighter. Does the pitch go up or down?

faq.a: Pitch is how high or low a sound is. A bird's tweet has a high pitch and a big drum has a low pitch.
asks: What makes a note high or low?

faq.q: Why do bigger instruments sound lower?
faq.a: Bigger instruments have longer, heavier strings or longer tubes of air, which vibrate more slowly. Slower vibrations make lower notes.
asks: Why does a double bass sound low?

faq.q: Which string instrument is the lowest?
faq.a: In the orchestra the double bass plays the lowest notes. From high to low the string family is violin, viola, cello and double bass.
asks: What is the biggest string instrument?
Order of string instruments high to low

faq.a: Frequency is how many times something vibrates each second, measured in hertz. Higher frequency means higher pitch. People can hear roughly 20 to 20,000 hertz.

faq.q: How does a guitarist change the pitch?
faq.a: By pressing a string onto the neck, which makes the vibrating part shorter so the note goes higher. Tightening a string also raises its pitch.
asks: Why do you press guitar strings?
How do strings make different notes?

facts: The lowest note on a standard 88-key piano is about 27.5 hertz and the highest is about 4186 hertz.
Young people can typically hear sounds from about 20 to 20,000 hertz.

quiz.say: Which instrument plays the lowest notes?
quiz.why: The double bass has the longest, heaviest strings, which vibrate slowest.

wrong.1: The violin is the smallest and plays highest.
wrong.2: The viola is only a little bigger than a violin, so it is still fairly high.

quiz.say: A guitarist presses a string to make it shorter. What happens to the pitch?
quiz.show: A shorter string makes the pitch…
quiz.why: A shorter string vibrates faster, which makes a higher note.

wrong.1: Lower notes come from longer strings.
wrong.2: Changing the length always changes the pitch.
